== Modern.arrow (line 2)
| arrow(day)
  case
    | day?
    | 1
    | 2, 3
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | name := "Monday"
    -
      instruction
        | name := "Midweek"
    -
      instruction
        | name := "Other"
  jump
    | return name

== Modern.expression (line 12)
| expression(day)
  case
    | day?
    | 1
    | 2
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | len := 6
    -
      call
        | work()
      instruction
        | len := 7
    -
      instruction
        | len := 0
  jump
    | return len

== Modern.work (line 24)
| work()
